units.zh: 耶律斡特剌孩裏竇景庸耶律引吉楊績趙徽王觀耶律喜孫
units.en: Yelu Wotela, Hai Li, Dou Jingyong, Yelu Yinji, Yang Ji, Zhao Hui, Wang Guan, and Yelu Xisun
units.literal: Yelu Wotela, Hai Li, Dou Jingyong, Yelu Yinji, Yang Ji, Zhao Hui, Wang Guan, Yelu Xisun

units.zh: 耶律斡特剌，字乙辛隱，許國王寅底石六世孫。
units.en: Yelu Wotela, whose style name was Yixin Yin, was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Xu of State, Yindi.
units.literal: Yelu Wotela, style name Yixin Yin, was a sixth-generation descendant of Prince Xu of State, Yindi.

units.zh: 少不喜官祿，年四十一，始補本班郎君。
units.en: As a young man he cared little for office and emolument; only at forty-one did he first receive appointment as an attendant of the standard corps.
units.literal: In youth he cared little for official salary and rank; not until age forty-one did he first receive appointment as an attendant of the standard corps.

units.zh: 時樞密使耶律乙辛擅權，讒害忠良，斡特剌恐禍及，深自抑畏。
units.en: At the time Yelu Yixin, Commissioner of Military Affairs, held power arbitrarily and slandered loyal ministers; fearing that disaster might reach him, Wotela kept himself deeply subdued and cautious.
units.literal: At the time the Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelu Yixin monopolized power and slandered the loyal and worthy; Wotela feared calamity would reach him and deeply restrained and humbled himself.

units.zh: 大康中，為宿直官，歷左、右護衛太保。
units.en: During the Dakang era he served on night duty at court and successively held the posts of Left and Right Guard Commissioner.
units.literal: In the Dakang era he served as a night-duty officer and successively held the posts of Left and Right Guard Commissioners.

units.zh: 大安元年，升燕王傅，徙左夷離畢。
units.en: In the first year of Da'an he was promoted to Tutor to the Prince of Yan and transferred to the post of Left Tribal Affairs Commissioner.
units.literal: In the first year of Da'an he was promoted to Tutor to the Prince of Yan and transferred to Left Tribal Affairs Commissioner.

units.zh: 四年，改北院樞密副使。
units.en: In the fourth year he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Northern Administration.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Northern Administration of the Imperial Secretariat.

units.zh: 帝賜詩褒之，遷知北院樞密使事，賜翼聖佐義功臣。
units.en: The emperor composed a poem in his praise, promoted him to Acting Commissioner of the Northern Administration, and granted him the merit title Worthy Assistant in Supporting the Sage.
units.literal: The emperor bestowed a poem in praise of him, promoted him to Acting Commissioner of the Northern Administration, and granted him the merit title "Worthy Assistant in Supporting the Sage."

units.zh: 北阻卜酋長磨古斯叛，斡特剌率兵進討。
units.en: When Mogusi, chief of the northern Zubu, rebelled, Wotela led troops to suppress him.
units.literal: The chief of the northern Zubu, Mogusi, rebelled, and Wotela led troops forward to suppress him.

units.zh: 會天大雪，敗磨古斯四別部，斬首千餘級，拜西北路招討使，封漆水郡王，加賜宣力守正功臣。
units.en: Heavy snow fell at the time; he defeated four of Mogusi's sub-divisions, took more than a thousand heads, was appointed Commissioner for Pacification of the Northwest Route, enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui Commandery, and further granted the merit title Upholding Integrity with Dedicated Strength.
units.literal: It happened that heaven sent heavy snow; he defeated four sub-divisions of Mogusi's forces, beheaded more than a thousand, was appointed Commissioner for Pacification of the Northwest Route, enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui Commandery, and further granted the merit title "Upholding Integrity with Dedicated Strength."

units.zh: 尋拜南府宰相。
units.en: He was soon appointed Chancellor of the Southern Administration.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Administration.

units.zh: 復討閘古胡裏扒部，破之，召為契丹行宮都部署。
units.en: He again campaigned against the Zanguhuliba tribe, defeated them, and was summoned to serve as Chief Deployer of the Khitan Imperial Camp.
units.literal: He again attacked the Zanguhuliba tribe, defeated them, and was summoned to serve as Chief Deployer of the Khitan Imperial Camp.

units.zh: 先是，北、南府有訟，各州府得就按之；
units.en: Previously, when the Northern and Southern Administrations had lawsuits, each prefecture and district could go on site to investigate them;
units.literal: Previously, when the Northern and Southern Administrations had lawsuits, each prefecture and district could go and investigate them on the spot;

units.zh: 比歲，非奉樞密檄，不得鞫問，以故訟者稽留。
units.en: in recent years, however, unless one held an order from the Military Affairs Commission, one could not conduct interrogations, and for this reason litigants were long detained.
units.literal: in recent years, unless carrying an order from the Military Affairs Commission, one could not conduct interrogations, and for this reason litigants were detained.

units.zh: 斡特剌奏請如舊，從之。
units.en: Wotela memorialized asking that the former practice be restored, and the court agreed.
units.literal: Wotela memorialized requesting that the old practice be restored, and the request was approved.

units.zh: 壽隆五年，復為西北路招討使，討耶睹刮部，俘斬甚眾，獲馬、駝、牛、羊各數萬。
units.en: In the fifth year of Shoulong he again served as Commissioner for Pacification of the Northwest Route and campaigned against the Yedugua tribe, capturing and beheading a great many and taking tens of thousands each of horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Shoulong he again served as Commissioner for Pacification of the Northwest Route, campaigning against the Yedugua tribe; he captured and beheaded a great many, and obtained tens of thousands each of horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.

units.zh: 明年，擒磨古斯，加守太保，賜奉國匡化功臣。
units.en: The following year he captured Mogusi, was promoted to Defender Grand Guardian, and was granted the merit title Supporting the State and Rectifying Transformation.
units.literal: The next year he captured Mogusi, was promoted to Defender Grand Guardian, and was granted the merit title "Supporting the State and Rectifying Transformation."

units.zh: 乾統初，乞致仕，不許，止罷招討。
units.en: At the beginning of Qiantong he asked to retire, but permission was refused; he was only removed from the pacification command.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qiantong he requested retirement, but was not permitted; he was only removed from the pacification command.

units.zh: 復兼南院樞密使，封混同郡王。
units.en: He again served concurrently as Commissioner of the Southern Administration and was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong Commandery.
units.literal: He again concurrently held the post of Commissioner of the Southern Administration and was enfeoffed as Prince of Huntong Commandery.

units.zh: 遷北院樞密使，加守太師，賜推誠贊治功臣。
units.en: He was transferred to Commissioner of the Northern Administration, promoted to Defender Grand Preceptor, and granted the merit title Sincere in Counsel and Praiseworthy in Governance.
units.literal: He was transferred to Commissioner of the Northern Administration, promoted to Defender Grand Preceptor, and granted the merit title "Sincere in Counsel and Praiseworthy in Governance."

units.zh: 致仕，薨，謚曰敬肅。
units.en: He retired from office, died, and was posthumously titled Jingsu.
units.literal: He retired, died, and was posthumously titled Jingsu.

units.zh: 孩裏，字胡輦，回鶻人。
units.en: Hai Li, whose style name was Hunian, was a Uyghur.
units.literal: Hai Li, style name Hunian, was a Uyghur.

units.zh: 其先在太祖時來貢，願留，因任用之。
units.en: His ancestors had come to offer tribute in the time of Taizu, asked to remain, and were therefore given office.
units.literal: His forebears had come to offer tribute in the time of Taizu, wished to remain, and were therefore employed in office.

units.zh: 孩裏重熙間歷近侍長。
units.en: During the Chongxi era Hai Li successively served as chief palace attendant.
units.literal: In the Chongxi era Hai Li successively served as chief palace attendant.

units.zh: 清寧九年，討重元之亂有功，加金吾衛上將軍，賜平亂功臣。
units.en: In the ninth year of Qingning he had merit in suppressing the rebellion of Chongyuan and was promoted to General-in-Chief of the Golden Crow Guard and granted the merit title Pacifier of Disorder.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Qingning he had merit in suppressing the rebellion of Chongyuan and was promoted to General-in-Chief of the Golden Crow Guard, granted the merit title "Pacifier of Disorder."

units.zh: 累遷殿前都點檢，以宿衛嚴肅稱。
units.en: He was repeatedly promoted until he became Commander of the Palace Front and was known for the strictness with which he maintained palace guard duty.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Commander of the Palace Front and was known for the strictness of his palace guard service.

units.zh: 大康初，加守太子太保。
units.en: At the beginning of Dakang he was promoted to Defender Heir Apparent Grand Guardian.
units.literal: At the beginning of Dakang he was promoted to Defender Heir Apparent Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 二年，加同中書門下平章事。
units.en: In the second year he was promoted to Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs with the Chancellery.
units.literal: In the second year he was promoted to Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs with the Chancellery.

units.zh: 三年，改同知南院宣徽使事。
units.en: In the third year he was transferred to Vice Director of the Southern Administration Commissioner of the Imperial Household.
units.literal: In the third year he was changed to Vice Director of the Southern Administration Commissioner of the Imperial Household.

units.zh: 會耶律乙辛出守中京，孩裏入賀；
units.en: When Yelu Yixin went out to guard the Central Capital, Hai Li entered court to offer congratulations;
units.literal: When Yelu Yixin went out to guard the Central Capital, Hai Li entered court to offer congratulations;

units.zh: 及議復召，陳其不可。
units.en: when the court deliberated recalling him, Hai Li argued that this should not be done.
units.literal: when deliberation turned to recalling him again, Hai Li stated that this should not be done.

units.zh: 後乙辛再入樞府，出孩裏為廣利軍節度使。
units.en: Later, when Yixin again entered the Military Affairs Commission, he had Hai Li sent out as Military Commissioner of Guangli Army.
units.literal: Later, when Yixin again entered the Military Affairs Commission, he had Hai Li sent out as Military Commissioner of Guangli Army.

units.zh: 及皇太子被誣，孩裏當連坐，有詔勿問。
units.en: When the crown prince was falsely accused, Hai Li would have been implicated by association, but an edict ordered that he not be prosecuted.
units.literal: When the crown prince was falsely accused, Hai Li would have been implicated by association, but an edict ordered that he not be prosecuted.

units.zh: 大安初，歷品達魯虢部節度使。
units.en: At the beginning of Da'an he successively served as Military Commissioner of the Pindaluoguo Division.
units.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he successively served as Military Commissioner of the Pindaluoguo Division.

units.zh: 壽隆五年，有疾，自言吾數已盡，卻醫藥，卒，年七十七。
units.en: In the fifth year of Shoulong he fell ill, declaring that his allotted span was exhausted; he refused medicine and died at seventy-seven.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Shoulong he fell ill, saying himself that his allotted span was exhausted; he refused medicine and died, aged seventy-seven.

units.zh: 孩裏素信浮圖。
units.en: Hai Li had long been a believer in Buddhism.
units.literal: Hai Li had long believed in Buddhism.

units.zh: 清寧初，從上獵，墮馬，憒而復蘇。
units.en: At the beginning of Qingning, while accompanying the emperor on a hunt, he fell from his horse, lost consciousness, and then revived.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, while accompanying the emperor on a hunt, he fell from his horse, lost consciousness, and then revived.

units.zh: 言始見二人引至一城，宮室宏敞，有衣絳袍人坐殿上，左右列侍，導孩裏升階。
units.en: He said that at first two men led him to a city of vast palaces and halls, where a man in a crimson robe sat upon the dais with attendants ranked to left and right, and they guided Hai Li up the steps.
units.literal: He said that at first he saw two men lead him to a city whose palaces and halls were vast and grand; a man in a crimson robe sat upon the dais, attendants stood in rows to left and right, and they guided Hai Li up the steps.

units.zh: 持牘者示之曰：「本取大腹骨欲，誤執汝。」
units.en: The man holding the document showed it to him and said, "We originally meant to take Dafugu, but mistakenly seized you."
units.literal: The man holding the document showed it to him and said: "We originally meant to take Dafugu, but mistakenly seized you."

units.zh: 牘上書「官至使相，壽七十七」。
units.en: On the document was written, "Office reaches commissioner and chancellor; lifespan seventy-seven."
units.literal: On the document was written: "Office reaches commissioner and chancellor; lifespan seventy-seven."

units.zh: 須臾還，擠之大壑而寤。
units.en: After a moment he was sent back, thrust into a great ravine, and awoke.
units.literal: After a moment he returned, was pushed into a great ravine, and awoke.

units.zh: 道宗聞之，命書其事。
units.en: Emperor Daozong heard of it and ordered the affair recorded in writing.
units.literal: Emperor Daozong heard of it and ordered the affair written down.

units.zh: 後皆驗。
units.en: Later events all proved it true.
units.literal: Later events all verified it.

units.zh: 竇景庸，中京人，中書令振之子。
units.en: Dou Jingyong was a native of the Central Capital and the son of Director of the Department of State Affairs Dou Zhen.
units.literal: Dou Jingyong was a man of the Central Capital and son of Director of the Department of State Affairs Zhen.

units.zh: 聰敏好學。
units.en: He was intelligent and loved learning.
units.literal: He was intelligent and quick-witted and loved learning.

units.zh: 清寧中，第進士，授秘書省校書郎，累遷少府少監。
units.en: During the Qingning era he passed the civil examinations, was appointed proofreader of the Secretariat, and was repeatedly promoted until he became Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.
units.literal: During Qingning he passed the civil examinations, was appointed proofreader of the Secretariat, and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.

units.zh: 咸雍六年，授樞密直學士，尋知漢人行宮副部署事。
units.en: In the sixth year of Xianyong he was appointed Academician of the Military Affairs Commission and soon served as Acting Deputy Deployer of the Han Imperial Camp.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Xianyong he was appointed Academician of the Military Affairs Commission and soon administered the affairs of Deputy Deployer of the Han Imperial Camp.

units.zh: 大安初，遷南院樞密副使，監修國史，知樞密院事，賜同德功臣，封陳國公。
units.en: At the beginning of Da'an he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration, supervised compilation of the National History, administered the Military Affairs Commission, was granted the merit title Meritous Minister of Shared Virtue, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Chen State.
units.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration, supervised compilation of the National History, administered the Military Affairs Commission, was granted the merit title Meritous Minister of Shared Virtue, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Chen State.

units.zh: 有疾，表請致仕，不從，加太子太保，授武定軍節度使。
units.en: When he fell ill he memorialized asking to retire, but permission was refused; he was promoted to Defender Heir Apparent Grand Guardian and appointed Military Commissioner of Wuding Army.
units.literal: When he fell ill he memorialized requesting retirement, but was not permitted; he was promoted to Defender Heir Apparent Grand Guardian and appointed Military Commissioner of Wuding Army.

units.zh: 審決冤滯，輕重得宜，以獄空聞。
units.en: In reviewing cases of wrongful detention he weighed severity and leniency appropriately and became known for emptying the prisons.
units.literal: In reviewing and deciding cases of wrongful detention, he weighed severity and leniency appropriately and became known for empty prisons.

units.zh: 七年，拜中京留守。
units.en: In the seventh year he was appointed Military Governor of the Central Capital.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed Military Governor of the Central Capital.

units.zh: 九年薨，謚曰肅憲。
units.en: In the ninth year he died and was given the posthumous title Suxian.
units.literal: In the ninth year he died and was posthumously titled Suxian.

units.zh: 子瑜，三司副使。
units.en: His son Yu served as Vice Commissioner of the Three Bureaus.
units.literal: His son Yu served as Vice Commissioner of the Three Bureaus.

units.zh: 耶律引吉，字阿括，品部人。
units.en: Yelu Yinji, whose style name was Akuo, was a man of the Pin tribe.
units.literal: Yelu Yinji, style name Akuo, was a man of the Pin tribe.

units.zh: 父雙古，鎮西邊二十餘年，治尚嚴肅，不殖貨利，時多稱之。
units.en: His father Shuanggu guarded the western frontier for more than twenty years; his governance was strict, he did not pursue profit, and at the time many praised him.
units.literal: His father Shuanggu guarded the western frontier for more than twenty years; his governance valued strictness, he did not pursue profit, and at the time many praised him.

units.zh: 引吉寅畏好義。
units.en: Yinji was cautious and respectful and loved righteousness.
units.literal: Yinji was cautious and respectful and loved righteousness.

units.zh: 以蔭補官，累遷東京副留守、北樞密院侍御。
units.en: Through hereditary privilege he entered office and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Military Governor of the Eastern Capital and Palace Attendant of the Northern Military Affairs Commission.
units.literal: Through hereditary privilege he entered office and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Military Governor of the Eastern Capital and Palace Attendant of the Northern Military Affairs Commission.

units.zh: 時蕭革、蕭圖古辭等以佞見任，鬻爵納賄，引吉以直道處其間，無所阿唯。
units.en: At the time Xiao Ge, Xiao Tuguci, and others were employed for their flattery, selling offices and accepting bribes; Yinji stood among them on the straight path and would not fawn or agree to anything.
units.literal: At the time Xiao Ge, Xiao Tuguci, and others were employed for their flattery, selling offices and accepting bribes; Yinji stood among them by the straight path and did not fawn or agree to anything.

units.zh: 改客省使。
units.en: He was transferred to the post of Reception Commissioner.
units.literal: He was transferred to Reception Commissioner.

units.zh: 時朝廷遣使括三京隱戶不得，以引吉代之，得數千餘戶。
units.en: At the time the court had sent envoys to register hidden households in the Three Capitals without success; Yinji replaced them and obtained more than several thousand households.
units.literal: At the time the court had sent envoys to register hidden households in the Three Capitals without success; Yinji replaced them and obtained more than several thousand households.

units.zh: 時昭懷太子知北南院事，選引吉為輔導。
units.en: At the time Crown Prince Zhaohuai oversaw the affairs of the Northern and Southern Administrations and selected Yinji as his instructor.
units.literal: At the time Crown Prince Zhaohuai oversaw the affairs of the Northern and Southern Administrations and selected Yinji as his instructor.

units.zh: 樞密使乙辛將傾太子，惡引吉在側，奏出之，為群牧林牙。
units.en: Commissioner of Military Affairs Yixin was about to bring down the crown prince and hated having Yinji at his side; he memorialized to have him sent out and appointed him Commissioner of Herds.
units.literal: The Commissioner of Military Affairs Yixin was about to bring down the crown prince and hated Yinji at his side; he memorialized to have him sent out and appointed him Commissioner of Herds.

units.zh: 大康元年，乙辛請賜牧地，引吉奏曰：「今牧地褊狹，畜不蕃息，豈可分賜臣下。」
units.en: In the first year of Dakang, Yixin requested that pasture lands be granted; Yinji memorialized, saying, "At present the pasture lands are narrow and cramped and livestock do not multiply—how can they be divided and granted to subordinates?"
units.literal: In the first year of Dakang, Yixin requested that pasture lands be granted; Yinji memorialized, saying: "At present the pasture lands are narrow and cramped and livestock do not multiply—how can they be divided and granted to subordinates?"

units.zh: 帝乃止。
units.en: The emperor thereupon stopped the matter.
units.literal: The emperor thereupon stopped the matter.

units.zh: 乙辛由是益嫉之，除懷德軍節度使，徙漠北猾水馬群太保，卒。
units.en: Yixin therefore hated him all the more, appointed him Military Commissioner of Huaide Army, transferred him to Grand Guardian of the Huashui Horse Herds in the far north, and he died.
units.literal: Yixin therefore hated him all the more, appointed him Military Commissioner of Huaide Army, transferred him to Grand Guardian of the Huashui Horse Herds in the far north, and he died.

units.zh: 楊績，良鄉人。
units.en: Yang Ji was a native of Liangxiang.
units.literal: Yang Ji was a man of Liangxiang.

units.zh: 太平十一年進士及第，累遷南院樞密副使。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Taiping he passed the civil examinations and was repeatedly promoted until he became Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Taiping he passed the civil examinations and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration.

units.zh: 與杜防、韓知白等擅給進士堂帖，降長寧軍節度使，徙知涿州。
units.en: Together with Du Fang, Han Zhibai, and others he arbitrarily issued jinshi hall credentials; he was demoted to Military Commissioner of Changning Army and transferred to administer Zhuo Prefecture.
units.literal: Together with Du Fang, Han Zhibai, and others he arbitrarily issued jinshi hall credentials; he was demoted to Military Commissioner of Changning Army and transferred to administer Zhuo Prefecture.

units.zh: 清寧初，拜參知政事，兼同知樞密院事，為南府宰相。
units.en: At the beginning of Qingning he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor, concurrently Vice Director of the Military Affairs Commission, and Chancellor of the Southern Administration.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor, concurrently Vice Director of the Military Affairs Commission, and served as Chancellor of the Southern Administration.

units.zh: 九年，聞重元亂，與姚景行勤王，上嘉之。
units.en: In the ninth year, on hearing of Chongyuan's rebellion, he marched with Yao Jingxing to aid the throne, and the emperor commended him.
units.literal: In the ninth year, hearing of Chongyuan's rebellion, he marched with Yao Jingxing to aid the throne, and the emperor commended him.

units.zh: 十年，知興中府。
units.en: In the tenth year he administered Xingzhong Prefecture.
units.literal: In the tenth year he administered Xingzhong Prefecture.

units.zh: 咸雍初，入知樞密院事。
units.en: At the beginning of Xianyong he entered court to administer the Military Affairs Commission.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he entered to administer the Military Affairs Commission.

units.zh: 二年，乞致仕，不許，拜南院樞密使。
units.en: In the second year he asked to retire, but permission was refused, and he was appointed Commissioner of the Southern Administration.
units.literal: In the second year he requested retirement but was not permitted and was appointed Commissioner of the Southern Administration.

units.zh: 帝以績舊臣，特詔燕見，論古今治亂，人臣邪正。
units.en: Because Ji was an old minister, the emperor specially summoned him to a private audience to discuss the order and disorder of ancient and modern times and the wickedness and rectitude of ministers.
units.literal: Because Ji was an old minister, the emperor specially summoned him to a private audience to discuss the order and disorder of ancient and modern times and the wickedness and rectitude of ministers.

units.zh: 帝曰：「方今群臣忠直，耶律玦、劉伸而已；
units.en: The emperor said, "Among the ministers today who are loyal and upright, only Yelu Jue and Liu Shen remain;
units.literal: The emperor said: "Among the ministers today who are loyal and upright, only Yelu Jue and Liu Shen remain;

units.zh: 然伸不及玦之剛介。」
units.en: yet Shen does not match Jue in firm integrity."
units.literal: yet Shen does not match Jue in firm integrity."

units.zh: 績拜賀曰：「何代無賢，世亂則獨善其身，主聖則兼濟天下。
units.en: Ji bowed in congratulation and said, "What age has lacked worthy men? When the age is chaotic one keeps oneself whole; when the ruler is sage one benefits all under Heaven.
units.literal: Ji bowed in congratulation and said: "What age has lacked worthy men? When the age is chaotic one keeps oneself whole; when the ruler is sage one benefits all under Heaven.

units.zh: 陛下銖分邪正，升黜分明，天下幸甚。」
units.en: Your Majesty minutely distinguishes the wicked and the upright and promotes and demotes with clarity—great fortune for the realm."
units.literal: Your Majesty minutely distinguishes the wicked and the upright and promotes and demotes with clarity—great fortune for the realm."

units.zh: 累表告歸，不許，封趙王。
units.en: He repeatedly memorialized asking to return home, but permission was refused, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
units.literal: He repeatedly memorialized asking to return home but was not permitted and was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

units.zh: 大康中，以例改王遼西。
units.en: During the Dakang era, by precedent his title was changed to Prince of Liaoxi.
units.literal: During Dakang, by precedent his princedom was changed to Liaoxi.

units.zh: 致仕，加守太保，薨。
units.en: He retired from office, was promoted to Defender Grand Guardian, and died.
units.literal: He retired, was promoted to Defender Grand Guardian, and died.

units.zh: 子貴忠，知興中府。
units.en: His son Guizhong administered Xingzhong Prefecture.
units.literal: His son Guizhong administered Xingzhong Prefecture.

units.zh: 趙徽，南京人。
units.en: Zhao Hui was a native of the Southern Capital.
units.literal: Zhao Hui was a man of the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 重熙五年，擢甲科，累遷大理正。
units.en: In the fifth year of Chongxi he passed the examinations in the top grade and was repeatedly promoted until he became Chief of the Court of Justice.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Chongxi he passed the examinations in the top grade and was repeatedly promoted to Chief of the Court of Justice.

units.zh: 清寧二年，銅州人妄毀三教，徽按鞫之，以狀聞，稱旨。
units.en: In the second year of Qingning a man of Tong Prefecture wantonly slandered the Three Teachings; Hui investigated and interrogated the case, reported it in a memorial, and pleased the emperor.
units.literal: In the second year of Qingning a man of Tong Prefecture wantonly slandered the Three Teachings; Hui investigated and interrogated the case, reported it in a memorial, and pleased the emperor's intent.

units.zh: 歷煩劇，有能名。
units.en: He passed through arduous and demanding posts and earned a reputation for ability.
units.literal: He passed through arduous and demanding posts and had a reputation for ability.

units.zh: 累遷翰林學士承旨。
units.en: He was repeatedly promoted to Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 咸雍初，為度支使。
units.en: At the beginning of Xianyong he served as Commissioner of Revenue.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he served as Commissioner of Revenue.

units.zh: 三年，拜參知政事。
units.en: In the third year he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.
units.literal: In the third year he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 出為武定軍節度使，及代，軍民請留。
units.en: He went out as Military Commissioner of Wuding Army, and when his term ended the soldiers and people asked that he be retained.
units.literal: He went out as Military Commissioner of Wuding Army, and when his term ended the soldiers and people asked that he be retained.

units.zh: 後同知樞密院事，兼南府宰相、門下侍郎、平章事。
units.en: Later he served as Vice Director of the Military Affairs Commission, concurrently Chancellor of the Southern Administration, Vice Minister of the Chancellery, and Director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: Later he served as Vice Director of the Military Affairs Commission, concurrently Chancellor of the Southern Administration, Vice Minister of the Chancellery, and Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 致仕，卒。
units.en: He retired from office and died.
units.literal: He retired and died.

units.zh: 追贈中書令，謚文憲。
units.en: Posthumously he was granted the title of Director of the Department of State Affairs and given the posthumous title Wenxian.
units.literal: Posthumously he was granted the title of Director of the Department of State Affairs and posthumously titled Wenxian.

units.zh: 王觀，南京人。
units.en: Wang Guan was a native of the Southern Capital.
units.literal: Wang Guan was a man of the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 博學有才辯。
units.en: He was broadly learned and had a gift for rhetoric.
units.literal: He was broadly learned and had talent for rhetoric.

units.zh: 重熙七年，中進士乙科。
units.en: In the seventh year of Chongxi he passed the civil examinations in the second grade.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Chongxi he passed the civil examinations in the second grade.

units.zh: 興宗崩，充夏國報哀使；
units.en: When Emperor Xingzong died, he served as envoy to the Xia state to announce the mourning;
units.literal: When Emperor Xingzong died, he served as envoy to the Xia state to announce the mourning;

units.zh: 還，除給事中。
units.en: on his return he was appointed Supervising Censor.
units.literal: on his return he was appointed Supervising Censor.

units.zh: 咸雍初，遷翰林學士。
units.en: At the beginning of Xianyong he was promoted to Hanlin Academician.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he was promoted to Hanlin Academician.

units.zh: 五年，兼乾文閣學士。
units.en: In the fifth year he additionally served as Academician of the Qianwen Pavilion.
units.literal: In the fifth year he additionally served as Academician of the Qianwen Pavilion.

units.zh: 七年，改南院樞密副使，賜國姓，參知政事，兼知南院樞密事。
units.en: In the seventh year he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration, granted the imperial surname, appointed Vice Grand Councilor, and concurrently Acting Commissioner of the Southern Administration.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Southern Administration, granted the imperial surname, appointed Vice Grand Councilor, and concurrently Acting Commissioner of the Southern Administration.

units.zh: 坐矯制修私第，削爵為民，卒。
units.en: He was punished for forging an edict to build a private residence, was stripped of his rank and reduced to commoner status, and died.
units.literal: He was punished for forging an edict to build a private residence, stripped of his rank and made a commoner, and died.

units.zh: 耶律喜孫，字盈隱，永興宮分人。
units.en: Yelu Xisun, whose style name was Yinyin, was a man of the Yongxing Palace Division.
units.literal: Yelu Xisun, style name Yinyin, was a man of the Yongxing Palace Division.

units.zh: 興宗在青宮，嘗居左右輔導。
units.en: When Xingzong was heir apparent in the Eastern Palace, Xisun had once served at his side as instructor.
units.literal: When Xingzong was in the Eastern Palace, Xisun had once served at his side as instructor.

units.zh: 聖宗大漸，喜孫與馮家奴告仁德皇后同宰相蕭浞卜等謀逆事。
units.en: When Emperor Shengzong was critically ill, Xisun together with Feng Jianu reported that Empress Rende, Chancellor Xiao Pobu, and others were plotting treason.
units.literal: When Emperor Shengzong was critically ill, Xisun together with Feng Jianu reported that Empress Rende and the chancellor Xiao Pobu and others were plotting treason.

units.zh: 及欽哀為皇太后稱制，喜孫尤見寵任。
units.en: When Empress Dowager Qin'ai assumed regency, Xisun was especially favored and trusted.
units.literal: When Empress Dowager Qin'ai assumed regency, Xisun was especially favored and trusted.

units.zh: 重熙中，其子涅哥為近侍，坐事伏誅。
units.en: During the Chongxi era his son Niege served as a palace attendant and was executed for an offense.
units.literal: In the Chongxi era his son Niege served as a palace attendant and was executed for an offense.

units.zh: 帝以喜孫有翼戴功，且悼其子罪死，欲世其官，喜孫無所出之部，因見馬印文有品部號，使隸其部，拜南府宰相。
units.en: Because Xisun had merit in supporting the emperor's accession and the emperor also grieved that his son had died for a crime, he wished to make his office hereditary; as Xisun had no division of origin, the emperor saw on a horse-brand the mark of the Pin tribe, had him attached to that tribe, and appointed him Chancellor of the Southern Administration.
units.literal: The emperor, because Xisun had merit in supporting his accession and also grieved that his son had died for a crime, wished to make his office hereditary; as Xisun had no division of origin, seeing on a horse-brand the mark of the Pin tribe, he had him attached to that tribe and appointed him Chancellor of the Southern Administration.

units.zh: 尋出為東北路詳穩，卒。
units.en: Soon afterward he was sent out as Detailed Inspector of the Northeast Route and died.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was sent out as Detailed Inspector of the Northeast Route and died.

units.zh: 論曰：孩裏、引吉之為臣也，當乙辛擅權、蕭革貪黷之日，雖與同官，而能以正自處，不少阿唯，其過人遠矣。
units.en: The commentary says: As ministers, Hai Li and Yinji lived in the days when Yixin monopolized power and Xiao Ge was greedy and corrupt; though they served alongside such men, they were able to maintain themselves by rectitude and would not fawn or agree—how far they surpassed others.
units.literal: The commentary says: As ministers, Hai Li and Yinji lived in the days when Yixin monopolized power and Xiao Ge was greedy and corrupt; though they held office with such men, they were able to maintain themselves by rectitude and did not fawn or agree—how far they surpassed others.

units.zh: 傳曰：「歲寒知松柏之後雕。」
units.en: The Classic says, "Only when the year turns cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither."
units.literal: The Classic says: "Only when the year turns cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither."

units.zh: 二子有焉。
units.en: These two men had it.
units.literal: These two men had it.

units.zh: 若斡特剌之戰功，竇景庸之讞獄，楊績之忠告，亦賢矣夫。
units.en: As for Wotela's military achievements, Dou Jingyong's adjudication of cases, and Yang Ji's loyal counsel—they too were worthy men indeed.
units.literal: As for Wotela's military achievements, Dou Jingyong's adjudication of cases, and Yang Ji's loyal counsel—they too were worthy men.

units.zh: 庚戌，皇孫延禧生。
units.en: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.
units.literal: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.

units.zh: 戊戌，皇子宗真生。
units.en: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.
units.literal: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.

units.zh: 己卯，封皇子重元秦國王。
units.en: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.
units.literal: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

units.zh: 冬十月，西北路酋長遐搭、雛搭、雙古等來降。
units.en: In the tenth winter month Northwest Route chieftains Xiadá, Choudá, Shuanggu, and others came to surrender.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Northwest Route chieftains Xiadá, Choudá, Shuanggu, and others came to surrender.

units.zh: 己丑，皇子隆緒生。
units.en: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.
units.literal: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.

units.zh: 戊戌，以蕭革、趙為果、耶律郁、馬保業充來歲賀宋正旦使副。
units.en: On wuxu day Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
units.literal: On wuxu day, appointed Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

units.zh: 辛巳，以戶部使劉詵為樞密副使。
units.en: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.
units.literal: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.

units.zh: 冬十二月壬午，以知樞密院事楊績為南院樞密使，樞密副使劉詵參知政事。
units.en: On renwu day of the twelfth winter month Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: Winter, twelfth month, on renwu day Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 十二月丁未，以參知政事劉詵為樞密副使，東北路詳穩高八南院大王，樞密直學士張孝傑參知政事。
units.en: On dingwei day of the twelfth month Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner; Northeast Route detail-stable Gao Ba Southern Court great king; Privy Council academician Zhang Xiaojie Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on dingwei day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner; Northeast Route detail-stable Gao Ba Southern Court great king; Privy Council academician Zhang Xiaojie Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 戊午，皇太叔重元與其子楚國王涅魯古及陳國王陳六、同知北院樞密使事蕭胡睹、衛王貼不、林牙涅剌溥古、統軍使蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉參及弟術者、圖骨、旗鼓拽剌詳穩耶律郭九、文班太保奚叔、內藏提點烏骨、護衛左太保敵不古、按答、副宮使韓家奴、寶神奴等凡四百人，誘脅弩手軍犯行宮。
units.en: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
units.literal: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

units.zh: 戊戌，遣杜防、蕭蘊充賀宋生辰使副。
units.en: On wuxu day Du Fang and Xiao Yun were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday.
units.literal: On wuxu day, dispatched Du Fang and Xiao Yun as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday.

units.zh: 壬申，以廣德軍節度使耶律蕊奴為南府宰相，度支使趙徽參知政事。
units.en: On renshen day Guangde Army military commissioner Yelü Ruinu was made Southern Court chancellor; Revenue Commissioner Zhao Hui was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: On renshen day Guangde Army military commissioner Yelü Ruinu was made Southern Court chancellor; Revenue Commissioner Zhao Hui Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 己丑，以南院樞密使蕭阿速為北府宰相，樞密副使耶律乙辛南院樞密使，惕隱查葛遼興軍節度使，魯王謝家奴武定軍節度使，東京留守吳王貼不西京留守。
units.en: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.
units.literal: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.

units.zh: 以耶律乙辛知北院樞密使事。
units.en: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

units.zh: 皇子洪基生。
units.en: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
units.literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

units.zh: 馮家奴等希欽哀意，誣蕭浞卜等謀反，連及嫡後仁德皇后。
units.en: Feng Jianu and others, eager to please Qin'ai, framed Xiao Hubu and his associates for treason and dragged in the legitimate empress, Ren'ade.
units.literal: Feng Jianu and others, courting Qin'ai's favor, falsely accused Xiao Hubu and others of plotting rebellion, implicating the legitimate empress Ren'ade.

units.zh: 興宗即位，欽哀皇后始得志，昆弟專權。
units.en: When Xingzong came to the throne, Empress Dowager Qin'ai finally had her way, and her brothers seized control of the government.
units.literal: When Emperor Xingzong took the throne, Empress Dowager Qin'ai at last had her way, and her brothers monopolized power.

units.zh: 戊寅，契丹阿保機遣使貢良馬。
units.en: On wuyin Abaoji sent fine horses as tribute.
units.literal: On wuyin the Khitan Abaoji sent envoys presenting fine horses.

units.zh: 甲午，以樞密副使姚景行為參知政事，翰林學士吳湛為樞密副使，參知政事、同知樞密院事韓紹文為上京留守。
units.en: On jiawu day associate privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Hanlin academician Wu Zhan associate privy commissioner; Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner Han Shaowen supreme capital regent.
units.literal: On jiawu day associate privy commissioner Yao Jingxing was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Hanlin academician Wu Zhan associate privy commissioner; Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate privy commissioner Han Shaowen supreme capital regent.

units.zh: 丁巳，漢人行宮都部署李仲禧、北院宣徽使劉霂、樞密副使王觀、都承旨楊興工各賜國姓。
units.en: On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Mu, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.
units.literal: On dingsi day Han mobile palace deployment director Li Zhongxi, Northern Court palace commissioner Liu Mu, associate privy commissioner Wang Guan, and chief usher Yang Xinggong were each granted the imperial clan surname.

units.zh: 壬子，出南府宰相韓知白為武定軍節度使，樞密副使楊績長寧軍節度使，翰林學士王綱澤州刺史，張宥徽州刺史，知制誥周白海北州刺史。
units.en: On renzi day, Han Zhibai was transferred from the post of Southern Court chancellor to serve as military commissioner of the Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Yang Ji was appointed military commissioner of the Changning Army; Hanlin academician Wang Gang was appointed prefect of Ze; Zhang You, prefect of Hui; and edict drafter Zhou Bai, prefect of Haibei.
units.literal: On renzi day, sent Southern Court chancellor Han Zhibai out to serve as military commissioner of the Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Yang Ji as military commissioner of the Changning Army; Hanlin academician Wang Gang as prefect of Ze; Zhang You as prefect of Hui; and edict drafter Zhou Bai as prefect of Haibei.

units.zh: 欽哀後謀廢立，遷於慶州。
units.en: When Qin'ai plotted to depose the emperor and enthrone another, she was banished to Qingzhou.
units.literal: Empress Dowager Qin'ai plotted deposition and enthronement, and was transferred to Qingzhou.

units.zh: 郡王貼不家奴彌裏吉告其主言涉怨望，鞫之無驗，當反坐，以欽哀皇后裏言，竟不加罪，亦不斷付其主，僅籍沒焉。
units.en: Miliji, a slave of Prince Junwang Tiebu, accused his master of disloyal speech; the charge could not be proved and the accuser should have been punished in turn, but at Qin'ai's private word he escaped punishment, was not returned to his master, and only had his property confiscated.
units.literal: The household slave Miliji of Prince Junwang Tiebu reported his master for words suggesting resentment; interrogation found no proof, and by law the accuser should be punished in turn; because of Empress Dowager Qin'ai's private word, he was in the end not punished, nor adjudged and returned to his master — only his property was registered for confiscation.

units.zh: 寧遠軍節度使蕭白強掠烏古敵烈都詳穩敵魯之女為妻，亦以後言免死，杖而奪其官。
units.en: Xiao Bai, commissioner of Ningyuan Army, forcibly took Dile's daughter as his wife; he too was spared death on the empress's word, beaten, and dismissed from office.
units.literal: Xiao Bai, military commissioner of Ningyuan Army, forcibly seized the daughter of Dile, detailed commander of the Uighur and Tatar tribes, as wife; he too was spared death on the empress's word, beaten, and stripped of office.

units.zh: 重熙元年，詔職事官公罪聽贖，私罪各從本法；
units.en: In the first year of Chongxi, an edict allowed functional officials to redeem public offenses, while private offenses were punished under the usual statutes;
units.literal: In the first year of Chongxi, an edict stated that functional officials' public offenses might be redeemed, while private offenses were each punished according to the applicable statute;

units.zh: 及奉迎以歸，頗復預事，其酷虐不得逞矣。
units.en: When she was brought back to court, she again meddled in state affairs, but she could no longer carry out her cruelties at will.
units.literal: When she was escorted back in welcome, she again took part in affairs to a considerable degree, yet her cruelty could no longer be indulged.

units.zh: 蓋自興宗時，遽起大獄，仁德皇后戕於幽所，遼政始衰。
units.en: From Xingzong's reign great purges began; Empress Ren'ade died in confinement—and Liao governance began its decline.
units.literal: From the time of Xingzong, great prisons were suddenly raised; Empress Ren'ade perished in confinement — Liao government began to decline.

units.zh: 浞卜等十餘人與仁德姻援，坐罪者四十餘輩皆被大辟，仍籍其家。
units.en: Hubu and more than ten others were connected to Ren'ade by marriage; over forty people implicated in the case were executed, and their families' property was confiscated.
units.literal: More than ten men including Hubu were related to Ren'ade by marriage; over forty persons convicted in the case were all sentenced to death, and their households were registered for confiscation.

units.zh: 幽仁德於上京，既而遣人弒之。
units.en: Ren'ade was imprisoned at Shangjing, and assassins were soon sent to kill her.
units.literal: Ren'ade was confined at Shangjing, and afterward men were sent to assassinate her.

units.zh: 迫殞非命，中外切憤。
units.en: Her violent death stirred fierce indignation throughout the court and the realm.
units.literal: Forced to die before her time, court and country alike were deeply outraged.

units.zh: 戊寅，追謚庶人浚為昭懷太子。
units.en: On wuyin day the commoner Jun was posthumously honored as Crown Prince Zhaohuai.
units.literal: On wuyin day posthumously honored the commoner Jun as Crown Prince Zhaohuai.

units.zh: 五月，皇弟剌葛、迭剌、寅底石、安端謀反。
units.en: In the fifth month his brothers Cige, Diela, Yindishi, and Anduan conspired to rebel.
units.literal: In the fifth month, his imperial brothers Cige, Diela, Yindishi, and Anduan plotted rebellion.

units.zh: 冬十月戊寅，剌葛破平州，還，復與迭剌、寅底石、安端等反。
units.en: In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.

units.zh: 己丑，以阻卜磨古斯為諸部長。
units.en: On jichou day Zubu Mogusi was made chief of all tribes.
units.literal: On jichou day Zubu Mogusi was made chief of all tribes.

units.zh: 辛酉，阻卜磨古斯殺金吾吐古斯以叛，遣奚六部禿裏耶律郭三發諸蕃部兵討之。
units.en: On xinyou day Zubu Mogusi killed Defender of the Golden Crow Tugusi and rebelled; Xi Six Tribes Tulie Yelü Guosan was dispatched to lead various tribal troops against him.
units.literal: On xinyou day Zubu Mogusi killed Defender of the Golden Crow Tugusi and rebelled; dispatched Xi Six Tribes Tulie Yelü Guosan to lead various tribal troops against him.

units.zh: 二月，磨古斯來侵。
units.en: In the second month Mogusi came to invade.
units.literal: Second month, Mogusi came to invade.

units.zh: 三月，西北路招討使耶律阿魯掃古追磨古斯還，都監蕭張九遇賊，與戰不利。
units.en: In the third month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Arusaguo pursued Mogusi back; inspector-general Xiao Zhangjiu encountered the bandits and fighting was unfavorable.
units.literal: Third month, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Arusaguo pursued Mogusi back; inspector-general Xiao Zhangjiu encountered the bandits and fighting was unfavorable.

units.zh: 冬十月庚戌，有司奏磨古斯詣西北路招討使耶律撻不也偽降，既而乘虛來襲，撻不也死之。
units.en: On gengxu day of the tenth winter month the relevant offices memorialized that Mogusi feigned surrender to Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Tabuye, then seized an opening to attack; Tabuye died in the fight.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengxu day the relevant offices memorialized that Mogusi feigned surrender to Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Tabuye, then seized an opening to attack; Tabuye died in the fight.

units.zh: 庚戌，以知北院樞密使事耶律斡特剌為都統，夷離畢耶律禿朵為副統，龍虎衛上將軍耶律胡呂都監，討磨古斯，遣積慶宮使蕭虬裏監戰。
units.en: On gengxu day Yelü Wotela, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made supreme commander; yilibi Yelü Tuduo deputy commander; Dragon-Tiger Guard upper general Yelü Hulu army supervisor to attack Mogusi; Jiqing Palace commissioner Xiao Qiuli supervised the campaign.
units.literal: On gengxu day Yelü Wotela, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made supreme commander; yilibi Yelü Tuduo deputy commander; Dragon-Tiger Guard upper general Yelü Hulu army supervisor to attack Mogusi; Jiqing Palace commissioner Xiao Qiuli supervised the campaign.

units.zh: 是月，斡特剌破磨古斯。
units.en: That month Wotela defeated Mogusi.
units.literal: That month Wotela defeated Mogusi.

units.zh: 戊子，西北路統軍司奏討磨古斯捷。
units.en: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.
units.literal: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.

units.zh: 耶律玦，重熙中同知遼興軍節度使事。
units.en: Yelu Jue served in Chongxi as deputy acting Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
units.literal: Yelu Jue, in Chongxi was associate knower of Liaoxing Army military commissioner affairs.

units.zh: 十二月庚辰，以知北院樞密使事蕭圖古辭為北院樞密使。
units.en: On gengchen day of the twelfth month Xiao Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on gengchen day, Xiao Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

units.zh: 辛亥，宋以即位，遣陳襄來報，即遣知黃龍府事蕭圖古辭、中書舍人馬鉉往賀。
units.en: On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; Xiao Tuguci, administrator of Huanglong Prefecture, and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan were immediately dispatched to congratulate.
units.literal: On xinhai day, because Song had acceded, Chen Xiang came to announce it; immediately dispatched Huanglong Prefecture administrator Xiao Tuguci and Secretariat drafter Ma Xuan to congratulate.

units.zh: 以耶律思忠、耶律荷、耶律暠、遙輦謝佛留、陳邈、韓紹一、韓知白、張震充賀宋兩宮生辰及來歲正旦使副。
units.en: Yelü Sizhong, Yelü He, Yelü Hao, Yaolian Xie Foliu, Chen Miao, Han Shaoyi, Han Zhibai, and Zhang Zhen were appointed envoys to congratulate both Song palaces on their birthdays and on New Year's Day of the coming year.
units.literal: Yelü Sizhong, Yelü He, Yelü Hao, Yaolian Xie Foliu, Chen Miao, Han Shaoyi, Han Zhibai, and Zhang Zhen were appointed envoys to congratulate Song both palaces on their birthdays and on New Year's Day of the coming year.

units.zh: 冬十月乙酉朔，以樞密副使竇景庸知樞密院事。
units.en: On the yiyou new moon of the tenth winter month associate privy commissioner Dou Jingyong was made administrator of Privy Council affairs.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou new moon, associate privy commissioner Dou Jingyong administrator of Privy Council affairs.

units.zh: 乙未，以北院宣徽使旅墳為左夷離畢，前南府宰相耶律喜孫東北路詳穩。
units.en: On yiwei day Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Lü Fen was appointed left yilibi, and former Southern Chancellor Yelü Xisun was made Northeast Route xiangwen.
units.literal: On yiwei day, made Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Lü Fen left yilibi and former Southern Chancellor Yelü Xisun Northeast Route xiangwen.

units.zh: 六月丁亥朔，以左夷離畢耶律坦為惕隱，知樞密院事耶律斡特剌兼知左夷離畢事。
units.en: On the dinghai new moon of the sixth month Left yilibi Yelü Tan was made tiyin; Yelü Wotela, who administered Privy Council affairs, also administrator of Left yilibi affairs.
units.literal: Sixth month, on dinghai new moon, Left yilibi Yelü Tan tiyin; Yelü Wotela, who administered Privy Council affairs, also administrator of Left yilibi affairs.
